class.name: exoskeleton_controllers/ExoImpedanceController
class.description: Chainable impedance controller for 6-DOF bipedal exoskeleton. Computes tau = Kp*(q_ref - q) + Kd*(qdot_ref - qdot) + tau_ff. Exports per-joint reference interfaces: target_position, target_velocity, feedforward_torque, kp, kd. Supports chained mode for NMPC/RL integration.
